text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass walls of the meeting room reveal an active gathering, a space of minds engaged in discourse. Just outside, the vibrant display of R+D speaks to progress and possibility. The combination of structured discussion and creative experimentation makes this environment stimulating and slightly restless—my mind wanders between observation and speculation about the nature of collaboration, innovation, and the boundaries of knowledge. I feel both like an outsider peering in and a participant in the larger pursuit of understanding.
